answer_1.quote: Generating passages that maintain long-range coherence is a long-standing problem in natural language generation.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the following automatic metrics to evaluate the generated stories in terms of (1) relevance, (2) diversity and (3) repetition. (1-a) BLEU (B-n) ... (1-b) MS-Jaccard (MSJ-n) ... (2-a) reverse-BLEU (rB-n) ... (2-b) Distinct (D-n) ... (3) Token Repetition (rep-l) ...

answer_4.quote: We hired three annotators from Amazon Mechanical Turk to give a preference (win, lose, or tie) in terms of coherence and diversity independently.
answer_4.guideline: Coherence measures whether the story stays on topic and is well-structured with correct logical, temporal, and causal relations. Informativeness measures whether the story contains informative details and is engaging on the whole.
